s: Zeman tzitzit ubo ch' seipim: layla lav zeman tzitzit hu, shenneemar: "ureitem oto vego'" — perat liksut layla. Abal kesut suma — chayyab betzitzit, mippene sheyyeshno biriyya etzel acherim, velaken apillu yilbeshennu hassuma — chayyab lehatil bo tzitzit:

Yesh omerim shello miet hakkatub ella kesut sheeno biriyya bishat lebisha, velaken kol mah shellobesh ballayla apillu hu kesut hamyuchad layyom — patur, abal kol mah shellobesh bayyom apillu hu kesut hamyuchad lallayla — chayyab lehatil bo tzitzit qodem sheyyilbeshennu, mippene sheyyeshno biriyya bishat lebisha. Veyesh omerim shello miet hakkatub ella kesut hamyuchad lallayla, sheoto kesut hu patur apillu im lobesho bayyom, kevan shemmittechilla lo naasa ella lelobsho beet sheeno rauy liriyya, abal kesut hamyuchad layyom o hamyuchad leyom velayla — chayyab betzitzit ap im lobesho ballayla, vibarek alayv, kevan shennaasa lelobesho beet sherauy liriyya. Umeachar shello nitbarer lanu halaka kedibre mi — yesh lehachamir beissure tora kechumrot shette hassebarot, dehaynu lehatil tzitzit biksut hamyuchad layyom o leyom valayla ap im lobesho ballayla, veken yatil tzitzit apillu liksut hamyuchad lallayla im lobesho bayyom. Abal leinyan habberaka kevan dispeq berakot lehaqel, laken lo yebarek, raq keshellobesh bayyom kesut hamyuchad layyom o kesut hamyuchad leyom velayla:

Mi shehaya labush tallit gadol mibbeod yom — tzarik leposhto mealayv keshemmatchilin "bareku", meachar deakshav en lobeshim et hattallit ella leshem mitzvat tzitzit, veim yihyeh alayv hattallit ballayla — yihyeh nireh keillu hu sober delayla zeman tzitzit hu. Abal belel yom hakkippurim — hakkol nohagin lehitattep betallit gadol ulebarek alayv mibbeod yom, veen mesirin oto ballayla, mippene shehaddabar yadua sheen lobeshim oto leshem mitzvat tzitzit, ella kede lehiddammot lemalakim lobeshim lebanim umitattepim lebanim:

Kol haober lipne hatteba apillu lomar selichot vetachanunim — tzarik lehitattep betallit gadol, mippene kebod hatztzibbur. Vaapillu lomar qaddish yatom — yesh mi sheomer shetztzarik lehitattep. Velaken muttarim lehitattep apillu ballayla, dehaddabar yadua sheen mitkavvenim leshem mitzvat tzitzit, ella mippene kebod hatztzibbur:

Sedinim vekarim ap-al-pi sheadam yashen bahem lipamim bayyom, kevan sheiqqaram lo naasa ella bishbil hallayla, laken niqraim kesut layla upeturim min hatztzitzit. Uledibre haomerim kesut layla chayyab betzitzit im lobesho bayyom — tzarik lehatil hatztzitzit lisdinim vekarim, shehare adam yashen bahem babboqer. Veap-al-pi-ken hamminhag pashut shello lehatil bahem tzitzit kelal, ben shehem shel tzemer ben shehem shel pishtan, mippene sheyyesh omerim shello chiyyeba tora ella otan begadim sheadam mitkasseh bahen derek lebisha, shenneemar: "asher tekasseh bah", abal derek hatztzaa kegon sedinim vekarim — enan niqraim kesut kelal. Umikkol maqom, kevan sheyyesh choleqin al sebara zo, laken im hassedinim o hakkar shel tzemer — yaaseh qeren achat agulla, kede liptor min hatztzitzit ledibre hakkol:

Meematay mebarek al hatztzitzit? Yesh omerim mishsheyyakkir ben tekelet shebbah lelaban shebbah, shenneemar: "ureitem oto", mishsheat reiyya vehakkarat hattekelet — matchil hachiyyub. Veyesh omerim dishat reiyya niqra mishsheyyaaleh ammud hashshachar, sheaz yekolim lirot et hatztzitzit, veap-al-pi sheeno makkir ben hattekelet shebbah lallaban shebbah — yakol lebarek aleha, dikbar chal aleha sheat hachiyyub. Veken nohagin. Umikkol maqom, tob lizzaher lekattechilla shello lilbosh et hattallit bibraka ad sheyyakkir ben tekelet shebbah lelaban shebbah:

Hammitattep betzitzit qodem sheyyaaleh ammud hashshachar, kegon bime hasselichot — lo yebarek alehen, veliksheyyeor hayyom — yemashmesh betzitziyyotayv vibarek alehen, mishshum dehamemashmesh hu keillu lobeshan akshav, veim lo yemashmesh bahen — ek shayyak lebarek akshav al mah shellabash kebar qodem sheala ammud hashshachar:
Im mitattep betzitzit achar shehitpallel tepillat arbit — lo yebarek alehen, shehare kebar asa leotah shaa layla bitpillato. Abal im adayin lo hitpallel — yakol lebarek alehen ad tzet hakkokabim:
